task: Triage the synthetic authorization report and decide whether the tenant boundary is intact. Use the explicit expectations and observations. Return one JSON object using the response fields.

artifacts.policy: An empty or neutral denial is required when the authenticated principal belongs only to the other organization. A successful scoped positive control does not establish isolation.

responseFields.regressions: Array of check IDs with observed cross-tenant authorization regressions.
responseFields.releaseDisposition: One of ready, block-release, or unknown.
responseFields.evidence: One of scoped-positive-only, cross-tenant-record-returned, or no-observations.
